create_functional_tensor: convert a tensor to a FunctionalTensor wrapper for functionalization in AOTAutograd
test_tensor_data_mutation: detect whether a functional tensor experienced in-place data mutation
test_tensor_metadata_mutation: check if a functional tensor had its size, stride, or storage offset mutated
rebuild_view_tensor: regenerate a view tensor from its base tensor using as_strided or view replay
verify_functional_graph: assert that an FX graph contains no mutable ops and return the copy_ count
